slots: Greetings little one. Please don't mind me.
It is just I, good old Beelzebub.
Story of the Helltaker again? Interesting...
Do you, by any chance, need a narrator?
Why please, allow me. It will be a pleasure.
You woke up one day with a dream.
It was, however, not an easy dream to achieve.
It could cost you your life.
"When demon girls are involved, no price is high enough."
You said, as you ventured down to hell.
You find yourself surrounded by the void.
I've tried many times. Haven't found much success so far.
Is there anything else you desire?
You want advice, but you have nobody to ask.
You haven't found any cute demons yet.
And no matter how cute I might be, I'm but a narrator.
Go find some harem worthy maidens so you can
pester them for advice to your heart's content.
We can figure something out at my place.
Maybe I can serve YOU instead?
You thought you're leaving hell alive? How delusional.
She took your face in her hands and snapped your neck with professional gentleness.
Sweet of you to offer. I could really use some coffee.
Since we travel together, I might as well do my job.
You've noticed how exploring hell takes a lot
of will? In hell, if you run out on will - you die.
Walking trough spikes takes twice the will.
The trick is to spend as little time on spikes as possible.
Thank you for relying on Hell's Customer Service.
How would you rate your overall satisfaction with provided help, on a scale from 1 to 10?
Thank you for your feedback. We are here to serve.
Whoa... Never got a ten before...
They always say that... and they always try to run away.
I'll have to break your knees, just in case.
She pulled out a sledgehammer. It was not going to be pretty.
Demon harem? You poor fool... They will rip you to shreds, and I HAVE to see this.
Advice? Easy. Skip all the puzzles, gather all the
bitches and let's engage in proper harem activities.
Please, forgive Modeus. Most demons are like her.
Lust for sin is in our blood, hard to keep it in check.
As for the puzzle... Try to not spend too much time kicking
around those undead slaves and you should be fine.
Are you a human? A real human? Please, take us with you.
This is getting too easy. I have questions.
We need a human to cross the hell's gate. You don't have to be in one piece, though.
They jumped you like rabid dogs. Canine sounds
included. The cuteness of it all gave you a heart attack.
Yes! At last! It's time to corrupt the mortal realm!
You don't look like you need help with this one.
Or you just wanted to talk?
Hey, do you smell that? Orange, berries and... vodka?
There's no doubt. That's got to be Malina.
She acts hard to get, but maybe you'll figure her out.
Then we will all hang out and it's gonna be FUN!
Great, more braindead idiots... Never seen your ugly face before.
I'd sure love to play with you.
This is delicious. Please, insult me more.
Fantastic. Just my luck to find another masochist creep.
She made a swiping motion and a fountain of
blood exploded from your devastated throat.
Like what... video games? Sure, why not. As
long as you're okay with turn based strategies.
Piece of a ritual. Forbidden lore, undoubtedly.
What? Never played rhythm based dungeon crawlers, have you?
If the rhythm of the spikes is not to your liking, just kick some rocks around until it does.
This place stinks of smoke. Zdrada must be close by.
Yo. I've heard about your harem. I'm in.
Wait. I have a feeling I'll regret it.
It's not really a harem anymore. We just play turn based strategies.
Holy shit. Let me put you out of your misery.
Your vision swam. The last thing you noticed
was a knife buried hilt deep between your ribs.
Too bad, I'm coming anyway. Go ahead, try to stop me.
Don't look at me for puzzle hints. I'm not a nerd.
Maybe go kill yourself on some spikes. It'll be amusing.
My sister's always like that. I can't believe you invited her...
Yeah. What were you thinking, man?
She spends too much time, all alone, playing the most nerdy video games I've ever seen.
Do you know how turned on she gets while playing them?
Kill one of us. Me or her. Please. Fast.
Just leave them be. You get used to it, eventually.
What do you think you're doing? Hey! W-
You had enough. You decided to follow Zdrada's advice and killed yourself on the spikes.
Oh my heavens! What would a living human be doing in hell? Most unusual.
You won't find many here. Lucky for you, I know a better place.
Who would've guessed that lying will get you into heaven.
Oh, you too? Let me guess, thesis on Modern
Sin? Or is it Demonology? We should join forces.
Say goodbye to your demon harem, though.
This one looks tricky. Might require some testing to find the perfect order of moves.
Please, take your time. Miss Modeus here is sharing
with me her considerably warped view on love.
...things can get violent, so moderation is
important. People die if you love them too much.
How fascinating. Please expand on that. I want to know all the details.
Yo, did you just solve that puzzle? That's awesome!
It took some work. Wanna join my harem?
I just skipped it in the menu. Wanna join my harem?
You don't have to ask me. I'd never miss a party.
That totally sounds like something I would've done.
Sure, let's go. The more the merrier, right?
We meet at last. You've proved yourself worthy by passing all my trials.
Pledge your soul to me and I'll make you my most treasured slave.
No, thanks. But you can join my harem.
As you knelt, she planted a kiss of your forehead, and your life melted away.
What are you trying to accomplish? You think you can enslave demons to your will?
Call me master. And ask for permission before you speak.
I can offer coffee, turn based strategies and chocolate pancakes.
I see I have to teach you your place.
She made a hand gesture, and all your blood
turned into vinegar. It's hard to explain the feel.
Really? Is that it? You come here, and try to buy me over with pancakes?
You're lucky I have a thing for pancakes.
I think you've convinced me. That harem of yours may prove to be entertaining after all.
If you can't do it, just skip it in the pause menu. I don't want to be sitting here all day.
Makes me wonder how you got here in the first place.
It looks like he can do miracles. He somehow got you out of your office after all.
True. He's the first one to not take the slave offer.
For a second there, I hoped he would give YOU a slave offer.
Justice... Don't give people ideas that will get them murdered.
Oh, come on. I'm sure you'd enjoy some maid roleplay.
Just look at all this mess. It seems nobody used the hell's gate in quite some time...
YOU TRULY THOUGHT YOU COULD JUST WALK AWAY?
You felt the biting cold of chains on your skin.
Followed by fire, burning the flesh from your bones.
It felt as if you've died a thousand deaths. Yet as the
flames subsided... Somehow, you were still alive.
I ONLY JUST FOUND YOU, TRESPASSER!
SO DON'T DIE ON ME YET.
WE WILL SPEND A LOT OF TIME TOGETHER, YOU AND I.
IGNITE THE SIN MACHINE! SUFFERING MUST BE MADE!
HOW DO YOU LIKE THE SIN MACHINE, TRESPASSER?
SURRENDER AND LET IT CONSUME YOU!
No, wait! Don't give up! You need to get us out of here!
And I'm still looking forward to my coffee.
LEAVE HOPE! HIS FATE IS SEALED!
Judgement, dear. This man may not know it, but he
belongs to me. Could you please not damage him?
BE SILENT! REAL WORK IS ABOUT TO BEGIN!
THOSE CHAINS THAT BIND YOU ARE MADE OF THINGS THAT BROUGHT YOU HERE.
YOUR EGO. YOUR GREED. YOUR LUST. YOU ARE YOUR OWN TORTURER.
Enough! High Prosecutor, I order you to stand down at once!
Keep going, Judgement! You are on the roll!
Yes, please continue. This is A+ material so far.
I'm supposed to be the goddamn Queen of Hell! Why is nobody ever listening to me?
YOU TRULY THINK YOU CAN BREAK FREE OF THOSE SHACKLES?
YOU SHOULD KNOW... HOPE LEADS TO
CHAINS OF DESPAIR ARE THE MOST DELIGHTFUL.
You must be cursed Malinka. You just found a fellow nerd and he's already done for.
Knowing my luck, he played Necropolis anyway.
I should've kept him for myself after all...
YES! REGRET EVERYTHING YOU'VE EVER DONE!
I love how you did your hair.
That outfit kills! Ten out of ten!
LIEEEEEEEES! THEY WON'T SAVE YOU FROM YOUR FATE!
I know. That's why I can be honest.
I also really like the claws!
IS THAT SO? IN THAT CASE, THANK YOU! I GUESS?
NOW LET'S GET BACK TO SUFFERING!
ANY LAST WORDS BEFORE THE REAL PAIN BEGINS?
Only thing I regret is not seeking you sooner.
Being punished by you makes all sins worth it.
QUIT YOUR CHEAP FLATTERIES! YOU MAKE MY JOB DIFFICULT!
But damn, you have amazing eyes.
Did I mention how much I love your hair?
Look. I don't really want to do this. But the pacts
been sealed. Nothing will prevent your damnation.
However... I could postpone your torment a few
years, if you leave and never disturb hell again.
Our fates are one. I will kill you and you'll suffer. But it does not have to be today...
SO CONSIDER YOURSELF LUCKY AND GET OUT OF MY SIGHT!
You'd share roof with an immortal avatar of pain,
blood-sworn to murder you through torture?
Wouldn't want it any other way.
Believe me, I have worse in my harem already.
Seeing how far off proper ritual we are already, I might as well give it a shot.
I SAID YOU ARE FREE TO GO! BEGONE!
WHAT? YOU WANT TO INVITE ME TO YOUR HAREM? DON'T BE RIDICULOUS!
Thus, your journey has come to an end.
You have successfully took girls from hell.
And was henceforth known as the Helltaker.
It was, however, not an easy life to live.
It was sure to be short and full of suffering.
But life is full of suffering no matter how you live it.
So you might as well have some fun when you're at it.
Another batch of pancakes done, I see.
Don't mention it. It's the least I can do.
Though I have to say, I still can't figure out how you get them perfectly thin every time.
And the way you spin them in the air. There must be some sorcery involved.
Yeah sure. Better go give everyone their pancakes.
Sure. But I could use some fire.
Or what? You'll punish me? Go ahead, I've been a very bad girl.
What is this? Did someone opened a portal at last?
Greetings little one. I am Beelzebub.
And you must be the chosen one. The King of Hell.
That means... I am nothing, but your humble servant.
Enter this gateway and take your rightful throne.
Hey. Is this a one-way banishment portal?
Beel! And here I hoped I'd never see your face again.
Don't believe a single word from Beelzebub The Exiled.
Most dangerous kind of demon. Forever sealed inside the Abyss.
Ask Justice. She was the High Prosecutor back then.
It was awesome. Wish you've seen that epic battle.
If you step through the portal, your soul will get
imprisoned too. Only madness waits for you there.
I've been here for quite some time and found no madness yet. Quite disappointing really.
A bit of mad would be refreshing. All you can find here is darkness and loneliness.
Just ignore this pest. I'll close the portal after dinner.
Harrasing neighbors again? What did you do?
Why is there police at the door?
Never heard of this "romance" stuff before. It's the kinkiest thing I've ever seen.
Maybe I've been doing things wrong all this time?
What, wanna go on a date?
I've always known you were a perverted degenerate.
TRESPASSERS SEEK TO INVADE OUR DOMAIN! SHOULD I DISPOSE OF THEM?
No need. I'll take care of this.
We know you're in there! Open the door NOW!
Oh, thanks. We still have questions though.
And that was the story of the Helltaker.
Narrated for you by good old Beelzebub.
Quite a silly tale, I know.
To be honest... downright abhorrent, actually.
But perhaps... you found some joy in it.
Still... thank you for keeping this old fly some company.
Do you know how hard it is to find new turn based strategies we could play?
Almost everything mankind produced is either a half-assed sequel or a shitty ripoff.
I would like to play them anyway.
We will need a lot of alcohol.
Awesome. I have a question though.
The girls say you never take off your shades. Why is that?
I could ask you the same.
That's my story. Care to share yours?
Oh, come on. The girls are already taking bets.
I'm losing 10 bucks if you don't have laser vision.
Oh no... It's quite alright actually. You even filtered it properely this time.
Keep it up and you might still survive the day with no fingers broken.
But do feel free to mess it up. The local hospital proved quite competent so far.
Next one at 5:15pm, double espresso, yes?
It's your job to remember. Not mine.
How long have I been here?
I could write a spectacular paper on this, but
nobody would believe me. It's just too surreal.
And my research has barely scratched the surface. Want to join me in my studies today?
You study too much. Eat your pancakes.
You find yourself surrounded by the void.
Shades of darkness you never knew existed.
You feel them rather than see them. Sight is no longer a concept.
Then, you are suddenly sick. With every illness known to man.
But you are not dying. Death is no longer a concept either.
You hear the buzzing. Thousands of flies swarm around you.
Then, a cloying wave hits you. The sweet smell is overwhelming. Unbearable...
Yet over the years to come, you'll learn to love it.
I simply can't believe you just did that.
Have you really bought that King of Hell crap? No, that simply can't be it. So why...
Wait. I don't think I really want to know.
Since we find ourselves stuck here for the foreseeable future...
I think a proper introduction should be made?
I have many names. The Sovereign of Pestilence, The
Warden of Decay, The Mistress of the Flies, The...
Wait, where are my manners? I have a guest. I should make myself more presentable.
Here. I think you will find this form a little more comfortable to converse with.
...also known as The Mistress of the Flies and The
Queen Crimson. Pleased to meet your acquaintance.
Welcome to the Abyss. Make yourself at home.
Here's an idea! I'll show you around my castle.
I think you'll love what I did with the place.
Why yes, I've built it myself. You'd be surprised what kind
of stuff can be made from the very fabric of darkness.
You brought something with you. If I knew you could
do that, I'd ask for some sweets. Demons love sugar.
This is the best day of my life.
And that was the story of the Helltaker.
Narrated for you by good old Beelzebub.
Please, forgive this little... self-insert at the end.
I know, I know... It was not supposed to be a
story about me. But I just couldn't help myself.
You may have questions, I assume. Had this
really happened? Where is the Helltaker now?
You just forgot after all those years in the Abyss.
Or maybe YOU don't even exist?
And I'm just a poor old fly talking to herself.
Hoho. For the sake of the story, some questions are better left unanswered.
Abyssal exile makes you seek the weirdest hobbies.
It starts like most tales do.
The protagonist wakes up one day with a dream.
But it is a feverish nightmare.
His body and mind are no longer his own.
Would you prefer to start from the beginning?
Or shall I proceed to the later stages of the story?
Another one's awake! And such a handsome specimen at that.
Are you the one who did this to me? Explain yourself at once!
I'm trying to create a perfect fusion between human and demon.
Let's put that delicious body through the next trial, shall we?
Mortality rate of the next trial is quite brutal. But don't worry, I have high hopes for you.
Enough of this! Release me or I'll show you how REAL suffering looks like!
According to data, you are Subject 66 of the
Triple six. Yes. There is power in such numbers.
If anyone can pass my examination, it's you.
Subject 66 died yesterday. This is Subject 67.
Why, thank you for ruining my hopes.
I'm coming for you, and if you think your toys will stop me, you're severely mistaken!
Sure, whatever. Since your chances of survival are
astronomically low, I might as well share with you a secret...
You see, I'm not a real demon. I'm actually an angel.
My research project required me to disguise as a
demon and climb to the top of hell's hierarchy.
You'd be surprised how easy taking hell over turned out to be.
They've underestimated my curiosity. Isn't that right, Lucy?
I've committed countless atrocities, true. But it was all in the name of science.
So that all sin can be analysed, documented and archived... Maybe even cured one day...
That's what makes angels different from demons. Motivation behind actions.
Keep talking to yourself, fiend. I'll have my hands around your neck soon enough.
You don't believe I'm an angel, do you?
I'd show you my halo... If only I knew where have I put it.
No, no, no! That's impossible. I must have left it in my other coat.
The next test is particularly sadistic. Have fun.
Well, I'll be damned! You are pretty good for a non-66 number. This is A+ material so far.
You do realise I can always skip puzzles from the menu, right?
It almost feels like I'm young again. Naive angel student writing a thesis on modern sin.
Of course, by now, I have completed exhaustive research
on all the sins in recorded history. Ten times over.
Yet, at the sight of anything mildly suggestive,
she's still sweating like a thirsty adolescent.
Lucy, please. I told you to ask for permission before you mock me.
My heavens, I can't believe this. You've actually
reached the final phase. No other subject got this far.
We have apple pies. Do you like apple pies? Pass
this last trial and you can have all the apple pies!
Is there any other reward you'd like? Just name it and it's yours!
I'll take from you everything you hold dear. I
think I'll start with your smug little demon maid.
Oh! I can see you know what's good in life!
I can confirm that Lucy is the absolute best there is.
She's smart, diligent and tries to assassinate me only twice a week.
And don't even get me started on the quality of her pancakes.
But I'm afraid you can't have her. I'd never give away my best girl.
We've successfully committed sin against creation itself.
Fantastic. Now move to the part where you surrender the apple pies, will you?
Those apple pies I promised you? We got a bit too excited and already ate them.
And when I say "we", I mean Lucy.
You'll have to wait until our chief apple pie scientist makes more.
Speak of the devil. Justice is a blessing that keeps on giving.
I hope you choke on them, you crazy witches!
Here's your apple pie. You deserved it.
Lucy, be a dear and fetch us some coffee too.
Subject 67, you are the first healthy and stable example of a new species of demon.
You have no idea how much we can learn from you.
And I want to learn EVERYTHING.
Now you look like a proper handsome demon.
Do you find my humiliation amusing, wretched imp?
Oh, come now. It looks good on you. Honest.
Not like you have much choice in how to dress. You're property of our little "angel" now.
Just like all of hell, actually. It's a bloody disgrace.
One day I'll have my crown back. Mark my words.
I wonder, though. When the time comes... Will
you side with me, or will you side with her?
You can be unpredictable, and therefore, useful.
She knows me well. But she does not know you.
I wonder how he's doing these days.
Think about what I said, okay?
You remind me of a man I once knew.
Chapter VIII - The CEO of Hell
